_comment: AOS Sprint 22 — Capacity Management. foundersAvailableDaysPerWeek is a starting-point assumption for a solo consultant (roughly one day/week reserved for business development, admin and AOS review out of a 5-day week) — edit it to reflect your real available bandwidth; no code change needed. weeksOfCommittedWorkThresholds bands the 'weeks of committed work at your available pace' figure into a status: Available Capacity below nearCapacity, Near Capacity between the two thresholds, Over Capacity at or above overCapacity.
